name: Can I reface cabinets and replace my appliances at the same time?

mainEntity.name: Can I reface cabinets and replace my appliances at the same time?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes, but appliances can expose the limits of a refacing plan. New refrigerators, dishwashers, ranges, and microwaves may require different openings, panels, filler strips, electrical connections, ventilation, or countertop adjustments.

Context: A new appliance can also reveal uneven floors, outdated connections, or insufficient clearance after the cabinet finish is updated. Appliance specifications should be available before final cabinet measurements.

Key factors:
- Exact appliance dimensions and manufacturer clearances.
- Electrical, gas, water, ventilation, and drain locations.
- Integrated or panel-ready appliance requirements.

Practical guidance: Choose or shortlist appliances before doors and panels are finalized, and provide the specification sheets to the design team. Confirm who coordinates deliveries, installation, and trade connections.

Elite Remodeling & Design can coordinate cabinetry with kitchen construction and appliance-related planning when the project goes beyond surface updates.
